sess_markdown.content: Show me how a reply looks in this interface.

Replies are GitHub-flavored Markdown.

- **Bold** and `inline code` stay in the bubble
- Fenced blocks keep their language

```js
function hello(name) {
  return `Hello, ${name}`;
}
```

| Piece | Where it lives |
| --- | --- |
| Chat | This column |
| Files | The album and the files panel |

> Approvals stay manual. Nothing runs until you choose.
